name: ArtNet Advanced Features
author: Daniel Kulp
description: Several Advanced ArtNet features including ArtNet Triggers and ArtNet TimeCodes

privacy.summary: Sends timecode and trigger packets to the ArtNet devices you list on your network. Once you turn triggers on, any device on your network can run FPP commands; nothing goes online.

sends.to: the timecode target addresses you enter (your whole network by default)
sends.what: the running playlist's position as ArtNet timecode
sends.why: so other show software on your network can follow FPP's playback

sends.to: the target address given in the Send ArtNet Trigger command
sends.what: an ArtNet trigger with the key, subkey and text you put in the command
sends.why: to trigger other ArtNet devices from a playlist or command

systemChanges.what: Opens FPP's ArtNet port (UDP 6454) on every network interface to receive triggers and timecode, once either is turned on

privacy.other: With trigger processing turned on, any device on your network that sends an ArtTrigger packet with the matching OEM code (default 0x2100) can run any FPP command, with no password. When FPP is a remote, incoming ArtNet timecode can start, stop and seek the chosen playlist. ArtNet is plain UDP, not encrypted. The plugin's settings file (config/plugin.fpp-ArtNetAdv) stays after uninstall.
